i.norm: When central-directory extra-field data declares a block length that exceeds the bytes actually available, the READ behavior keeps the raw bytes in an UnparseableExtraFieldData holder. Merging that holder back to bytes must reproduce the original 4-byte input unchanged.
A 4-byte field: header id {0,0}, declared length from bytes {0xC2,0x00} (194), which is far larger than the 4 bytes present -> unparseable.
Parse as central-directory data (local = false); READ retains the raw bytes.
